title: 第28章 莲香教
content_zh:
魏乐府作为铜章捕快，田牧川给他分到了五个铁尺捕快。

    并且表示让魏乐府不要有压力。

    对此，魏乐府也表示他只能尽力而为。

    然后他就去了风闻司查资料看情报，他想要找到莲香教那就得先知道莲香教是什么。

    看完资料后，魏乐府略有些红温。

    他本以为莲香教是类似于白莲教、太平道之类的势力，结果看完之后发现，他娘的就是纯邪教。

    诈骗、敛财这都算是好的了，还有各种非人道的仪式等等。

    不过洗脑能力和传播性非常强，也难怪能渗透到整个大靖朝各地。

    然后他就发现了一个有趣的东西，那就是莲香教也是有武学的。

    它并非单纯的邪教，还掺杂了一定的江湖性质。

    其教中有一门名为清莲宝卷的武学，和八宝金身类似属于特殊的武学。

    一般小势力可没办法拥有这种特殊武学，不过没人知道莲香教总部在哪里。

    因此也是只知道有这么一份武学。

    魏乐府则是在思考，如果说沈千钧是主角的话，那会不会因为他的缘故让这门武学机缘巧合来到定远城？

    毕竟原定给他的八宝金身传承被魏乐府毁了，肯定得补新的武学。

    他怀疑沈千钧的重楼功、宝塔桩以及明堂劲快要圆满了，所以需要新的武学来填充，以此让沈千钧进一步成长。

    不然这种机缘巧合不可能接连出现两次。

    如果真被魏乐府猜对了，或许能够借着这次机会转移注意力。

    魏乐府并不是得陇望蜀之人，对于他来说，目标只有龙髓淬血丹。

    他也不可能说沈千钧有一个机缘或者奇遇他就去摧毁或者截胡一次。

    这风险很大的，一不留神他自己都得折进去了。

    就他这些行为，那可是在跟主角作对，没看到他到现在为止都不敢冒头呢。

    他可是全靠田牧川等人在前头顶着，他可不敢直接针对，不然十有八九是一冒头就被秒。

    当然，如果真有机会，魏乐府也不会作壁上观。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu was a copper-badged agent, and Tian Muchuan assigned him five iron-stick agents.

    He also asked Wei Yuefu not to feel pressure.

    In this regard, Wei Yuefu also said that he could only do his best.

    Then he went to the Rumor Department to look up information. If he wanted to find the Lianxiang Sect, he had to first know what the Lianxiang Sect was.

    After reading the information, Wei Yuefu felt a little warm.

    He originally thought that the Lotus Sect was a force similar to the White Lotus Sect and the Taiping Tao, but after reading it, he discovered that it was a pure cult.

    Scams and money-making are considered good, but there are also various inhumane rituals and so on.

    However, the brainwashing ability and dissemination are very strong, so it is no wonder that it can penetrate into all parts of the Jing Dynasty.

    Then he discovered something interesting, that is, the Lianxiang Sect also has martial arts.

    It is not a pure cult, but also has a certain Jianghu nature.

    There is a martial arts in his teaching called Qinglian Baojuan, which is a special martial arts similar to the Eight Treasures Golden Body.

    Generally, small forces cannot possess this kind of special martial arts, but no one knows where the headquarters of the Lotus Sect is.

    Therefore, I only know that there is such a martial arts.

    Wei Yuefu was thinking, if Shen Qianjun was the protagonist, would it be because of him that this martial arts came to Dingyuan City by chance?

    After all, the inheritance of the Eight Treasures Golden Body originally planned for him was destroyed by Wei Yuefu, so he would definitely have to make up for it with new martial arts skills.

    He suspected that Shen Qianjun's Chonglou Kung, Pagoda Zhuang and Mingtang Jin were about to be perfected, so new martial arts were needed to fill them in to allow Shen Qianjun to grow further.

    Otherwise, this kind of chance coincidence would not happen twice in succession.

    If Wei Yuefu guessed it correctly, he might be able to use this opportunity to divert his attention.

    Wei Yuefu is not someone who wants to go to Shu. For him, the only goal is the Dragon Marrow Blood Tempering Pill.

    It is impossible for him to say that if Shen Qianjun has an opportunity or encounter, he will destroy or intercept him.

    This is very risky. If he is not careful, he will get in.

    His behavior is against the protagonist. I didn't see that he didn't dare to show up until now.

    He relied on Tian Muchuan and others to carry him forward. He didn't dare to directly target him, otherwise he would most likely be killed as soon as he showed up.

    Of course, if there is a chance, Wei Yuefu will not sit back and watch.
